title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Country…
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Country allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects Country versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.1.3, from 2.2.0 to 2.2.1.
